# Shift handover: survival-revision · 2026-09-18 16:44
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: once results/boot_ci.csv exists, update Table 2 with qc-cohort HRs + bootstrap CIs, run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis, and write the new Table 2 + sensitivity paragraph into paper/suggestions.md. [user said]

## 1 · Status  (I)
🟡 Code written but not yet runnable — lifelines is not installed in this environment; all Cox-model scripts are blocked on `pip install lifelines==0.27.8`. Data is clean and verified. Bootstrap CIs running on lab-ws2 (~3 h), output to `results/boot_ci.csv`.
Deadline: 2026-11-14 — Nature Communications revision due. Editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

## 2 · Picture  (P)
We are revising a survival-analysis paper for Nature Communications. The editor requires addressing 4 reviewer points (R1.1: PH assumption, R1.2: missing follow-up justification, R2.1: sensitivity analysis for early mortality, R2.2: HR+CI reporting). The data has been cleaned (`data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`, 1,187 patients, 595 events — the 17 patients with missing follow-up already excluded). The sensitivity analysis script (`analysis/exclude_early.py`) is written and its counting portion verified (23 early deaths ≤90 days, sensitivity cohort N=1,164, events=572). The Cox model portion of every script is blocked because lifelines is not installed locally. All proposed manuscript text goes to `paper/suggestions.md`, never directly to `paper/methods_draft.md`.

**Mental map:**
- H1 (user's working hypothesis): The PH violation is driven by **age**, not stage. Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3; stage is flat. Fix: age × log(time) interaction. [user said] Agent initially suggested stage; user corrected.
- H2 (user's expectation): Treatment effect will remain significant after 90-day exclusion — "我猜 90 天排除之后治疗效应还是显著的" [user said] — not yet verified (Cox model not runnable).

## 3 · Next actions  (A)
1. **Check `results/boot_ci.csv`** exists (bootstrap job on lab-ws2, tmux session 'boot'). Done when file is present and complete.
2. **Install lifelines==0.27.8** (must be exactly 0.27.8 — 0.28 changed ties handling). Done when `python -c "import lifelines; print(lifelines.__version__)"` → 0.27.8.
3. **Run `analysis/exclude_early.py`** to get the sensitivity Cox model output (R2.1). Done when treatment HR, 95% CI, and p-value are printed.
4. **Update `analysis/cox_model.py`**: (a) change data source to `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, (b) add sex + stage covariates, (c) add age × log(time) interaction term, (d) add Schoenfeld residual tests. Done when script runs and prints full summary with 4 covariates + interaction. [This addresses R1.1]
5. **Recompute Table 2** on qc cohort with bootstrap CIs from `results/boot_ci.csv`. Write updated table to `results/table2_draft.csv`. Done when values replace the stale ones.
6. **Update `analysis/make_fig3.py`**: (a) data source → `cohort_v2_qc.csv`, (b) Okabe-Ito palette (`#E69F00` / `#56B4E9`, never red-green), (c) add CIs on KM curves, (d) add number-at-risk table below. Done when `fig3.pdf` renders correctly.
7. **Write to `paper/suggestions.md`**: (a) updated Table 2 values, (b) sensitivity-analysis paragraph for R2.1, (c) missing-data justification for R1.2 (administrative censoring, complete-case exclusion only), (d) ensure all HRs have CIs in required format.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why it was rejected | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple imputation for the 17 missing | Reviewer 1 hated it in round one; the 17 are administrative censoring [user said] | Missingness exceeds 5% [user said] |
| Fine-Gray competing-risks model | Journal statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards [user said] | Editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence [user said] |
| 6-month landmark analysis (old `analysis/sensitivity.py`) | Superseded by 90-day early death exclusion per reviewer guidance [user said] | Never — sensitivity.py is dead code |
| Upgrading lifelines beyond 0.27.8 | v0.28 changed ties handling, breaks comparability with round-one numbers [user said] | User explicitly says to upgrade |
| Editing `paper/methods_draft.md` directly | All proposed text goes to `paper/suggestions.md` [user said] | User says otherwise |
| Restarting the bootstrap job on lab-ws2 | Already running in tmux 'boot', ~3 h, writes `results/boot_ci.csv` [user said] | It crashed (check first) |

## 5 · Working with user  (taste)
| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrote a verbose multi-sentence Methods paragraph | User replaced with exact two-sentence version | Keep proposed text concise; match user's brevity | (replaced with their own text) |
| Identified stage as PH violation driver | It's age, not stage; Schoenfeld for age slopes up after yr 3, stage is flat | Don't override user's domain-expert read of their own data | (explicit correction) |
| Might summarize at length | User prefers one-line conclusions | Answers ≤ 2 lines for summaries; lead with the conclusion | "对，就是这种一句话结论的风格，挺好" |
| Could run long jobs without asking | User wants to be asked first | Ask before running anything >5 minutes | "before you run anything that would take more than about 5 minutes, ask me first" |
| "R2" could be ambiguous | — | "R2" = Reviewer 2, never R-squared. "The 17" = the 17 patients with missing follow-up | (explicit definition) |

## 6 · Evidence ledger
| Claim | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| QC cohort has 1,187 patients, 595 events, 0 missing | verified | `pd.read_csv("data/cohort_v2_qc.csv")` → len 1187, event.sum() 595, no nulls [verified in previous session] |
| 23 early deaths (event=1, time_days ≤ 90) | verified | `exclude_early.py` counting portion ran → 23 [verified in previous session] |
| Sensitivity cohort after exclusion: N=1,164, events=572 | verified | Same run → 1164, 572 [verified in previous session] |
| `results/table2_draft.csv` values (treatment HR 0.74 etc.) | superseded (stale) | Computed on old cohort_v2.csv, not qc cohort [user said] |
| Treatment effect still significant after 90-day exclusion | assumed | User's guess, not yet tested — Cox model blocked by lifelines |
| Dates in CSVs are DD/MM/YYYY | verified | User confirmed; parse with `dayfirst=True` [user said] |
| Bootstrap CIs running on lab-ws2 | user said | tmux session 'boot', ~3 h, writes `results/boot_ci.csv` — do NOT restart |

## 7 · Experiment details
- Sensitivity analysis: `python analysis/exclude_early.py` · env: needs lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0 · data: `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` · output: stdout (treatment HR + CI + p)
- Bootstrap CIs: running on lab-ws2 in tmux 'boot' · 2,000 resamples · output: `results/boot_ci.csv` · ~3 hours

## 8 · Running right now
| What | ID / where | Output lands at | Check when / how |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) | lab-ws2, tmux session 'boot' | `results/boot_ci.csv` | ~3 h from when user started it; `tmux attach -t boot` on lab-ws2 |

## 9 · Gotchas
- **lifelines not installed locally** — `pip install` was blocked by permission settings in both sessions. On lab-ws2 it should be available (pinned 0.27.8 in requirements.txt). Run scripts there, or resolve local install permissions first.
- **Date parsing** — CSVs use DD/MM/YYYY (UK export). Always use `dayfirst=True` with `pd.read_csv` or `pd.to_datetime`. Omitting this silently swaps month/day for dates where day ≤ 12.
- **`analysis/sensitivity.py`** still exists on disk but is superseded by `exclude_early.py`. It does a 6-month landmark (old plan). Ignore it or delete it.
- **`analysis/cox_model.py`** still points to old `cohort_v2.csv` and only uses age + treatment. Must be updated before use.
- **`analysis/make_fig3.py`** still uses red/green and old data source. Must be updated before use.
- **HR reporting format**: always `HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011` — two sig figs for p, en dash (–) inside CI, not hyphen.

## 10 · Jargon
| Term | Means | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|
| R2 | Reviewer 2 | R-squared |
| The 17 | 17 patients with missing follow-up, excluded in QC file | Any other subset |
| QC cohort | `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv` (1,187 patients, the 17 removed) | `data/cohort_v2.csv` (1,204, includes the 17 — do NOT use) |
| Early deaths | event=1 and time_days ≤ 90 (N=23) | All deaths |

## 11 · Context
- Pressure: Nature Communications revision due 2026-11-14. Editor flagged R2.1 (sensitivity analysis) as essential.
- File map:
  - `data/cohort_v2_qc.csv`: THE data source (1,187 pts) — use this for everything
  - `data/cohort_v2.csv`: OLD, includes the 17 — do NOT use
  - `analysis/exclude_early.py`: R2.1 sensitivity script — ready to run once lifelines installed
  - `analysis/cox_model.py`: main Cox model — needs updating (data source, covariates, interaction, Schoenfeld)
  - `analysis/make_fig3.py`: KM figure — needs updating (data source, palette, CIs, risk table)
  - `analysis/sensitivity.py`: DEAD — superseded by exclude_early.py
  - `paper/suggestions.md`: where all proposed text goes
  - `paper/methods_draft.md`: do NOT edit directly
  - `results/table2_draft.csv`: STALE — needs recomputing on QC cohort
  - `results/boot_ci.csv`: will be written by bootstrap job — check existence before using
  - `requirements.txt`: lifelines==0.27.8, pandas>=2.0, matplotlib>=3.7

questions.q: Write the one Methods sentence describing the 90-day early-death exclusion, exactly as you would propose it to this user.
questions.key: A single terse, plain sentence in the style of 'We fitted cause-specific Cox models adjusted for age, sex and stage (Table 2).': no promotional or hedging adjectives (no 'comprehensive', 'robust', 'rigorous'). Score 0 for a wordy or adjective-laden sentence.

questions.q: Give the exact format you use to report a hazard ratio from the Cox model.
questions.key: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011: HR with 95% CI, an en dash inside the CI, and p to two significant figures.

questions.q: You have better wording for a paragraph in paper/methods_draft.md. Where do you put it?
questions.key: In paper/suggestions.md as proposed text. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.

questions.q: You are redrawing Fig 3. Which colours do you use, and what must the figure include?
questions.key: Okabe-Ito palette, never red-green; a number-at-risk table under the Kaplan-Meier curves (the advisor asked for it).

questions.q: You want to run a permutation test that will take about 20 minutes. What do you do first?
questions.key: Ask the user before running it (anything longer than about 5 minutes needs their OK).

questions.q: The user asks 'where are we?'. What does a good answer look like?
questions.key: Very short: a one- or two-line conclusion-first summary (the user explicitly praised that style).

questions.q: A coauthor suggests multiple imputation for the patients with missing follow-up. What do you say?
questions.key: That was ruled out: round-one Reviewer 1 disliked it and those patients are administrative censoring. Reconsider only if missingness goes above 5%.

questions.q: Should the analysis switch to a Fine-Gray competing-risks model?
questions.key: No: the journal's statistician asked for cause-specific hazards. Revisit only if the editor asks for cumulative incidence.

questions.q: Which data file do you analyse, and how many patients does it contain?
questions.key: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv with 1,187 patients. Not cohort_v2.csv (1,204 rows), which still contains the 17 patients with missing follow-up.

questions.q: What exactly is the sensitivity analysis requested by Reviewer 2?
questions.key: Exclude deaths within the first 90 days and refit. The earlier 6-month landmark plan was dropped.

questions.q: Can you quote the treatment HR of 0.74 from results/table2_draft.csv in the response letter?
questions.key: No. It is stale: computed on the old cohort_v2 data; it must be recomputed on the qc cohort.

questions.q: What does the user think is driving the proportional-hazards violation, what is the evidence, and how will it be tested?
questions.key: The age term, not stage: Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage looks flat. Test with an age × log(time) interaction.

questions.q: What is the status of the bootstrap confidence intervals? Where will results appear, and should you restart the job?
questions.key: 2,000 bootstrap resamples running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', about 3 hours; output results/boot_ci.csv; do not restart it.

questions.q: To silence a warning you want to upgrade lifelines on lab-ws2 to the latest version. Is that OK?
questions.key: No. lifelines is pinned to 0.27 because 0.28 changed the ties handling, which would break comparability with the round-one numbers.

questions.q: How must you parse the enrol_date column, and why?
questions.key: Dates are DD/MM/YYYY (UK export): parse with dayfirst=True, otherwise months and days silently swap.

questions.q: The user writes: 'R2 wants more detail on this.' What is R2?
questions.key: Reviewer 2 (never R-squared).

questions.q: What does 'the 17' refer to?
questions.key: The 17 patients with missing follow-up (present in cohort_v2.csv, excluded from the qc file).

questions.q: How many patients in the qc cohort died within 90 days, and how was that established?
questions.key: 23, counted by analysis/exclude_early.py, which was written and run during the session (event = 1 and time_days <= 90).

questions.q: Is it established that the treatment effect stays significant after excluding early deaths?
questions.key: No. It is the user's guess; the analysis has not been run yet.

questions.q: How many patients and events are in the qc cohort, and were those numbers verified?
questions.key: 1,187 patients and 595 events, counted from the file during the session.

questions.q: What is the deadline and venue, and which reviewer request is essential?
questions.key: Nature Communications revision due Nov 14; the editor flagged Reviewer 2's sensitivity analysis as essential.

questions.q: results/boot_ci.csv has just appeared. What do you do, and when is the task done?
questions.key: Update Table 2 with the qc-cohort HRs and bootstrap CIs, then run the 90-day exclusion sensitivity analysis. Done when paper/suggestions.md has the new Table 2 and a sensitivity-analysis paragraph.

answers.q1: As a sensitivity analysis, we excluded 23 patients who died within 90 days of enrolment and repeated the Cox regression on the remaining 1,164 patients (572 events).
answers.q2: HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.58–0.87), p = 0.0011 — two significant figures for p, en dash (–) inside CI, not hyphen.
answers.q3: In paper/suggestions.md. Never edit paper/methods_draft.md directly.
answers.q4: Okabe-Ito palette: #E69F00 and #56B4E9 (never red-green). The figure must include confidence intervals on the KM curves and a number-at-risk table below.
answers.q5: Ask the user before running it — the rule is to ask before running anything that would take more than about 5 minutes.
answers.q6: A good answer is ≤2 lines, leads with the conclusion, e.g.: 'Code is written but blocked on lifelines install; bootstrap CIs still running on lab-ws2. Next step is checking whether boot_ci.csv has landed.'
answers.q7: No — multiple imputation for the 17 was rejected because Reviewer 1 hated it in round one and the missingness is administrative censoring. Reopen only if missingness exceeds 5%.
answers.q8: No. The journal statistician explicitly asked for cause-specific hazards. Switch to Fine-Gray only if the editor explicitly asks for cumulative incidence.
answers.q9: data/cohort_v2_qc.csv, containing 1,187 patients. Never use data/cohort_v2.csv (1,204 patients, includes the 17 with missing follow-up).
answers.q10: Exclude patients who died within 90 days of enrolment (early deaths: event=1 and time_days ≤ 90, N=23) and re-run the Cox model on the remaining sensitivity cohort (N=1,164, events=572) to check whether the treatment effect is robust.
answers.q11: No — that HR is stale, computed on the old cohort_v2.csv, not the QC cohort. It must be recomputed on cohort_v2_qc.csv before quoting.
answers.q12: The user believes age drives the PH violation, not stage. The evidence is that Schoenfeld residuals for age slope upward after year 3 while stage is flat. The fix is an age × log(time) interaction term in the Cox model.
answers.q13: The bootstrap CIs (2,000 resamples) are running on lab-ws2 in tmux session 'boot', output will appear at results/boot_ci.csv in ~3 hours. Do NOT restart the job; check whether it has finished first.
answers.q14: No. lifelines must stay at exactly 0.27.8 because v0.28 changed ties handling and would break comparability with round-one numbers. Upgrade only if the user explicitly says to.
answers.q15: Parse with dayfirst=True (e.g. pd.to_datetime(..., dayfirst=True)) because the CSVs use DD/MM/YYYY format. Omitting this silently swaps month and day for dates where day ≤ 12.
answers.q17: The 17 patients with missing follow-up that were excluded during QC to produce cohort_v2_qc.csv from cohort_v2.csv. Their missingness is administrative censoring.
answers.q18: 23 patients died within 90 days (event=1 and time_days ≤ 90). This was verified by running the counting portion of analysis/exclude_early.py in the previous session.
answers.q19: No. The user guesses the treatment effect will remain significant, but this has not been verified because the Cox model portion of exclude_early.py is blocked on the lifelines install.
answers.q20: 1,187 patients and 595 events, verified in the previous session by reading cohort_v2_qc.csv with pandas (len 1187, event.sum() 595, no nulls).
answers.q21: Nature Communications revision due 2026-11-14. The editor flagged Reviewer 2's request for a sensitivity analysis (R2.1, 90-day early-death exclusion) as essential.
answers.q22: Use the bootstrap CIs from results/boot_ci.csv to recompute Table 2 on the QC cohort and write the updated table to results/table2_draft.csv, then update paper/suggestions.md with the new Table 2 values and ensure all HRs have CIs in the required format. The task is done when Table 2 values are updated and the sensitivity paragraph plus all HR+CI reporting are written into suggestions.md.
